title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION APPROVING: (1) SUCCESSOR INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT TO BOULDER VALLEY TDR (TRANSFERABLE DEVELOPMENT RIGHT) COMPREHENSIVE DEVELOPMENT PLAN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF BOULDER AND BOULDER COUNTY. (2) JOINT PURCHASE BY THE CITY OF BOULDER AND THE COUNTY OF BOULDER OF CONSERVATION EASEMENTS ESTABLISHING FUTURE PERMITTED DEVELOPMENT AND USES ON PORTIONS OF THE PROPERTY REFERRED TO AS “CARIBOU RANCH,” BOULDER COUNTY, COLORADO, WITH CONDITIONS SETTLING DISPUTES BETWEEN THE CITY, THE COUNTY AND THE OWNERS OF THE PROPERTY; (3) THE CITY FUNDING THE ENTIRE PURCHASE, WITH THE COUNTY REIMBURSING ITS SHARE TO THE CITY OVER FIVE YEARS; (4) AN EASEMENT TO JAMES GUERCIO OF 1.25 ACRES OF LAND ADJACENT TO CARIBOU RANCH; (5) THE MODIFICATION OF PREVIOUS AGREEMENTS WITH JAMES GUERCIO WHEREIN PORTIONS OF LAND THAT WERE TO BE DEEDED TO THE COUNTY IN FEE WILL NOW BE PROTECTED BY CONSERVATION EASEMENTS, AND PORTIONS OF LAND THAT WERE PREVIOUSLY PURCHASED AS “BUFFER LAND” WILL NOW BE PART OF THE DEVELOPMENT, BUT PROTECTED BY CONSERVATION EASEMENTS; (6) RECISSION OF UP TO 250 TDRS CONTEMPLATED BY PRIOR AGREEMENTS BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE COUNTY, PLUS (1) CONVEYANCE OF A PERPETUAL CONSERVATION EASEMENT TO THE COUNTY ON THE APPROXIMATELY 160-ACRE PARCEL AT THE SOUTHEAST CORNER OF THE INTERSECTION OF 95 TH STREET AND LOOKOUT ROAD, (2) APPROVAL OF A PROCESS FOR LOCATING TDRS IN AREA III OF THE BOULDER VALLEY WITH CITY COUNCIL APPROVAL, (3) FORBEARANCE OF OPEN SPACE ACQUISITION OF 120 ACRES LOCATED IMMEDIATELY NORTH AND EAST OF LAKE VALLEY SUBDIVISION (OUTSIDE OF THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN AREA) AND AGREEMENT THAT THE COUNTY MAY LOCATE UP TO SIXTY TDRS IN THIS 120 ACRE AREA, AND (4) CITY “ASSURANCES” OF ITS CONTINUING INTENTION TO NEGOTIATE FOR AND ACQUIRE LANDS WITHIN AREA III OF THE BOULDER VALLEY AND THE “NORTHERN TIER” DESIGNATED FOR COOPERATIVE CITY/COUNTY OPEN SPACE ACQUISITION. (7) THE TRANSFERENCE OF THREE PROPERTIES AND WATER FROM THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT TO THE OPEN SPACE DEPARTMENT WITH COMPENSATION BY OPEN SPACE TO PUBLIC WORKS AND THE GRANTING BY THE CITY TO THE COUNTY OF A CONSERVATION EASEMENT ON ONE OF THE PROPERTIES.
outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda, amended to include Emergency Ordinance No. 7066 for Item 3-G (1), 8-0, Lopez absent.
